topics.name: raspberry pi radar-node summary
topics.notes: Default topology: each Raspberry Pi radar node publishes a reduced derived summary. The backend coalesces node reports into home-summary.v1 for the operator dashboard.

topics.name: raspberry pi radar-node health
topics.notes: Operational health only: CPU, memory, temperature, RSSI, buffered packet count, retry/backoff state. No raw range-Doppler maps.
